design_reference: Editeur Livre-Jeu - Wireframes.dc.html § 02 « Choix sortants » (choice rows with « ⊘ pré-requis caché » + « ⏱ compte à rebours » pills), § 05 « Choix à pré-requis caché » and « Choix sous compte à rebours » (the BINDING detail for those two mechanics), and § 06 A « Créer une nouvelle branche » + B « Relier à un nœud existant » (the search popover + the dashed « fuite ↻ » relink edge). Anatomy + tokens from styles.css: ListRow, Field, Select, Badge, the search popover. Low-fi, light theme.

plan.goal: Manage a node's outgoing choices: create a new child branch, relink a choice to an existing node, and configure per-choice rules — hidden prerequisite (requires an inventory object) and countdown (expires to a default node).

design_contract._binding: Rebuild § 02 choices + § 05 mechanics + § 06 linking with design-system components; DS tokens win over prose. This feature is mounted inside node-editor's reserved choices slot.
design_contract.choice_rows: Each outgoing choice = a `surfaces/ListRow`-style card: « → <destination title> » + a wrap of mono `Badge`s for active rules (⊘ pré-requis caché, ⏱ compte à rebours). Header action « + branche ».
design_contract.new_branch: § 06 A: « + Nouvelle branche » creates a new child node (empty, with placeholder), already edged from this choice, and selects it for editing. Visualized as a solid `choice` edge.
design_contract.relink: § 06 B: « ↪ Relier… » opens a search popover (var(--shadow-menu)) listing existing nodes (title + #ref, current match highlighted accent); choosing one points the choice at that node, creating a `relink`/`fuite` edge (dashed on canvas) — enabling loops and convergences.
design_contract.hidden_prereq: § 05: a toggle « Conditionné à un objet » + a required-item picker (Chip from the book inventory). The choice is hidden from the reader unless the object is in inventory; shown as a ⊘ Badge on the row.
design_contract.countdown: § 05: a toggle « Activer le compte à rebours » + a délai Select + an « à expiration → nœud » Select; shown as a ⏱ Badge. A progress bar illustrates the mechanic in-editor only.
design_contract.empty_state: A node with no choices shows an inviting « + Ajouter une branche » affordance (project-wide empty-state rule).

acceptance_criteria: A node's outgoing choices are listed as rows showing the destination title and a badge per active rule; the list is read from BookService and reflects edges live (edge:* events).

« + Nouvelle branche » creates a new child node via BookService, links it from this choice with a `choice` edge, and selects the new node (emits node:created + edge:created{kind:'choice'} + node:selected); the new node starts empty with placeholders.

« Relier… » opens a searchable list of existing nodes; selecting one creates a `relink` edge from this choice to that node (edge:created{kind:'relink'}) without creating a node, enabling cycles/convergence; the canvas renders it dashed.

Toggling « pré-requis caché » on a choice and picking a required object persists a hidden-prerequisite rule referencing an ObjectCatalogService object id; the choice row shows the ⊘ badge; clearing the toggle removes the rule.
Toggling « compte à rebours » persists a délai + a fallback destination node; the row shows the ⏱ badge; the fallback target must resolve to an existing node.
The countdown délai is a free numeric seconds input defaulting to 15 s and clamped to 5–60 s; values outside the range are corrected to the nearest bound.
Removing a choice deletes its edge (edge:deleted) and, for the relink case, never deletes the target node — only the edge; deleting a `choice` branch prompts about its now-orphaned child if any.
A required-object reference that points at a deleted object, or a fallback/relink target pointing at a deleted node, is detected and surfaced (not silently broken).
All controls render from design-system components/tokens, light theme; the relink search is keyboard-navigable and rules have ≥44px targets.
plan.walking_skeleton: Render the selected node's outgoing choices from BookService. « + branche » creates+links+selects a child (emit node:created/edge:created/node:selected). « Relier… » lists nodes and creates a relink edge. Persist a basic hidden-prereq object reference and a countdown fallback. No search-fuzzy/progress-bar polish yet.

iterations.goal: Choice rows + new branch (§ 06 A): list outgoing choices as rows with rule badges; « + Nouvelle branche » creates+links+selects a child node with placeholders; emit the three events. Design-system fidelity.
Relink (§ 06 B): searchable node popover, create a `relink`/`fuite` edge to an existing node enabling cycles/convergence; canvas shows it dashed; guard self-link and duplicate edges (KR-061).
Hidden prerequisite (§ 05): toggle + required-object picker referencing ObjectCatalogService by id; choice hidden unless owned; ⊘ badge; clean removal (KR-062).
Countdown (§ 05): toggle + délai + fallback-node Select with validation; ⏱ badge; referential-integrity sweep for deleted targets/objects across all rules (KR-063).

known_risks: KR-060 — Edges are the book's structure: all create/delete goes through BookService so tree-canvas + outline-view + game-preview agree; never mutate edges locally (re-asserts KR-020).

KR-061 — Relink must allow cycles/convergence by DESIGN but guard degenerate cases: no duplicate identical edges, sane handling of self-links, and the target node is never created/deleted by relinking (only the edge).

KR-062 — Hidden prerequisite references an object by STABLE id from ObjectCatalogService, not by name (names duplicate and change); a dangling reference to a deleted object must be detected, not silently true/false.

KR-063 — Countdown fallback + relink targets are node references that can dangle if the target is deleted; run a referential-integrity check and surface broken targets rather than crashing the reader later (re-asserts KR-021).
KR-064 — Deleting a `choice` branch may orphan its child subtree; prompt/handle explicitly (don't silently leave unreachable nodes or cascade-delete without consent).

KR-065 — Cumulative rules: a choice may hold BOTH a hidden prerequisite and a countdown; the countdown must be gated on visibility (only ticks when the prerequisite is met), so a hidden choice never expires invisibly.
KR-011 — No raw localStorage; all edges/rules via BookService/ObjectCatalogService (global config KR-111).
KR-013 — Derive row/rule view-state inline from book data, not useEffect mirrors (global config KR-113).
A11y — relink search and rule toggles fully keyboard-operable; popover traps focus and restores it on close.

resolved_decisions: Two linking modes — new branch vs relink to existing — both required (the user asked for both; relink enables loops/convergence).
Hidden-prerequisite and countdown are per-choice rules (the digital-only mechanics from § 05).
Mounted inside node-editor's choices slot; choice-linking owns edges, node-editor owns node text.

A single choice CAN carry both a hidden prerequisite AND a countdown simultaneously; the countdown only runs while the choice is visible (i.e. when its hidden prerequisite is satisfied) — a hidden choice does not tick down in the background.
Countdown délai is a FREE numeric input (seconds), default 15 s, clamped to a 5–60 s range.
